Fidel component docsየፊደል ክፍሎች ሰነድ

Every Fidel web component: what it does, who it helps, a live example, code to copy, its attributes and events, and accessibility notes.እያንዳንዱ የፊደል ዌብ ክፍል፦ ምን እንደሚሰራ፣ ማንን እንደሚረዳ፣ የቀጥታ ምሳሌ፣ የሚቀዳ ኮድ፣ መለያዎቹ (attributes) እና ክስተቶቹ (events)፣ እንዲሁም የተደራሽነት ማስታወሻዎች።

የእያንዳንዱ ክፍል ገጾች በእንግሊዝኛ ናቸው።

Getting startedለመጀመር

Add two lines to your pageሁለት መስመሮችን ወደ ገጽዎ ያክሉ

Put these in your page's head. From the free jsDelivr CDN, with no Fidel server:እነዚህን በገጽዎ head ውስጥ ያስቀምጡ። ከነጻው jsDelivr CDN፣ ያለ ፊደል ሰርቨር፦

<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/y0hannesHK/fidel-alx-hackathon@v1.0.0-cdn/fidel.css">
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/y0hannesHK/fidel-alx-hackathon@v1.0.0-cdn/fidel.js" defer></script>

Or from your own Fidel server, which also serves lessons, jobs and certificates. The /embed/v1/ address never gets breaking changes:ወይም ትምህርቶችን፣ ሥራዎችን እና ሰርተፊኬቶችን ከሚያቀርበው ከራስዎ የፊደል ሰርቨር። የ/embed/v1/ አድራሻ ነባሩን የሚያበላሽ ለውጥ አይደረግበትም፦

<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://YOUR-FIDEL-HOST/embed/v1/fidel.css">
<script src="https://YOUR-FIDEL-HOST/embed/v1/fidel.js" defer></script>

Your first playerየመጀመሪያ ማጫወቻዎ

Add a fidel-player tag where the lesson goes. With your own video and caption files, no server is needed:ትምህርቱ በሚገባበት ቦታ የfidel-player ታግ ያክሉ። በራስዎ የቪዲዮ እና የካፕሽን ፋይሎች ሰርቨር አያስፈልግም፦

<fidel-player src="lesson.mp4" captions-en="en.vtt" captions-am="am.vtt"
              chapters="chapters.vtt" lang="en"></fidel-player>

<fidel-player>: all attributes and events

Other components load by themselvesሌሎቹ ክፍሎች በራሳቸው ይጫናሉ

fidel.js holds the player, job card, session viewer and certificate. Every other component is in fidel-components.js and fidel-components.css, and fidel.js loads them by itself, only when the page uses one of those tags. So a page with only a player downloads less, and you still add only one script tag.fidel.js ማጫወቻውን፣ የሥራ ካርዱን፣ የክፍለ ጊዜ መመልከቻውን እና የምስክር ወረቀቱን ይዟል። ሌሎቹ ክፍሎች በሙሉ fidel-components.js እና fidel-components.css ውስጥ ናቸው፤ ገጹ ከእነዚህ ታጎች አንዱን ሲጠቀም ብቻ fidel.js በራሱ ይጭናቸዋል። ስለዚህ ማጫወቻ ብቻ ያለው ገጽ ያነሰ ያወርዳል፤ እርስዎም አንድ የስክሪፕት ታግ ብቻ ያክላሉ።

A page that creates component tags from its own script before they are needed can load the second file directly:ክፍሎቹ ከመፈለጋቸው በፊት በራሱ ስክሪፕት የሚፈጥራቸው ገጽ ሁለተኛውን ፋይል በቀጥታ መጫን ይችላል፦

<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://YOUR-FIDEL-HOST/embed/v1/fidel-components.css">
<script src="https://YOUR-FIDEL-HOST/embed/v1/fidel-components.js" defer></script>

Settings in, events outመቼቶች ይገባሉ፣ ክስተቶች ይወጣሉ

Set attributes on the tag, and listen for its events like any DOM event. Events bubble and carry no personal data.በታጉ ላይ መለያዎችን (attributes) ያስቀምጡ፤ ክስተቶቹንም (events) እንደማንኛውም የDOM ክስተት ያዳምጡ። ክስተቶቹ ወደ ላይ ይተላለፋሉ፤ የግል መረጃ አይዙም።

document.addEventListener('fidel-ended', (e) => markLessonDone(e.target.id));

All componentsሁሉም ክፍሎች

Grouped by what they are for. Each link opens the page for that component.በአገልግሎታቸው የተመደቡ ናቸው። እያንዳንዱ ማስፈንጠሪያ የዚያን ክፍል ገጽ ይከፍታል።

Type a tag, a name or who it helps, for example Deaf or quiz.ታግ፣ ስም ወይም የሚረዳውን ሰው ይጻፉ፤ ለምሳሌ Deaf ወይም quiz።

Video and lessonsቪዲዮ እና ትምህርቶች

The player, and the tags that work with it on a lesson page.

  • <fidel-player>: Lesson player

    The accessible lesson video player: captions in three languages, sign language, transcript, audio description and offline lessons.

  • <fidel-session-viewer>: Recorded live session

    A recorded live class with captions and transcript, and its Zoom chat beside it.

  • <fidel-lesson-formats>: Choose how to take the lesson

    Buttons for Watch, Listen, Read, Sign language and Simple words; only the formats the lesson has are offered, each with its download size.

  • <fidel-code-snapshots>: Code in sync with the video

    Lists code blocks in time order; while the video plays, the current one shows "Now" and is announced once.

  • <fidel-lesson-map>: Where am I, and jump anywhere

    A lesson navigation with jump links to the parts on the page, chapter buttons, and "You have watched 40%".

  • <fidel-progress>: Lesson progress

    A progress bar and "40% watched", from the player's progress events; "Say my progress" reads it out.

  • <fidel-mark-complete>: Mark as complete

    A "Mark as complete" toggle button, usable once the video reaches the end (or at any time with manual).

  • <fidel-notes>: My notes, at a time in the video

    Timestamped notes kept only in this browser: "Add a note at 1:23", play from a note, Edit, Delete with Undo, download as .txt.

  • <fidel-question>: Ask about this moment

    A button under the player that opens a dialog to ask about the current moment in writing, by voice note or in sign language.

  • <fidel-caption-report>: Report a caption problem

    Learners tell staff when a caption is wrong; the report arrives in Fidel Studio on the lesson's page.

Reading and understandingማንበብ እና መረዳት

Code, diagrams, hard words, simpler text, quizzes and tables that everyone can read.

  • <fidel-code-block>: Code block

    Code that a screen reader and a Braille display can read: Copy, Read line by line, Symbols as words, and "Play from 1:23".

  • <fidel-described-image>: Diagram with a full description

    A <figure> with alt text, a caption and a "Full description" that opens under the image.

  • <fidel-word>: Tap a hard word for its meaning

    The word becomes a button that opens a small dialog with a plain English and an Amharic meaning.

  • <fidel-read-aloud>: Listen to a paragraph

    A Listen / Stop button for a paragraph; the sentence being read is highlighted and underlined.

  • <fidel-steps>: Instructions one step at a time

    "Step 2 of 5" with Previous, Next, "I did this step" and "Show all steps"; progress is remembered.

  • <fidel-simple-mode>: A simpler version of the same text

    A "Simple words" switch between the full text and a simpler, hand-written version.

  • <fidel-callout>: Callout: tip, warning, example or note

    A box with a real heading; the type is said in words ("Warning: …"), never by colour alone.

  • <fidel-table>: Tables that fit a phone

    Wraps a real <table>: adds header scopes, becomes "Header: value" cards when narrow, and can sort.

  • <fidel-quiz>: Quiz with a timer you control

    Questions as fieldsets with real radio buttons or checkboxes, feedback in words, and an optional timer that can be extended or switched off.

  • <fidel-toggletip>: Toggletip: an info button

    An info button that shows a short explanation on click, tap, Enter or Space, never on hover only.

  • <fidel-reading-guide>: Reading guide

    Outlines the paragraph you are in, can dim the rest, and moves block by block with Next line and Previous line.

Sign language and Deaf accessየምልክት ቋንቋ እና መስማት ለተሳናቸው ተደራሽነት

Signs for tech words, answers in sign language, and sounds you can see.

  • <fidel-sign-term>: A tech word with its sign

    The word becomes a button that opens a dialog with a muted, looping sign-language clip and the meaning in English and Amharic.

  • <fidel-sign-answer>: Answer in sign language

    Record a short video answer with the camera, watch it back, then send it; or use the phone's camera app.

  • <fidel-visual-alert>: Sounds you can see

    Shows a banner (icon and text) for things other people would hear; optional vibration; never flashes.

Offline and dataከመስመር ውጭ እና ዳታ

For cheap phones, expensive data and connections that come and go.

  • <fidel-data-saver>: Data saver: know the size first

    Shows the size before anything downloads, with a choice of the full video or a smaller version.

  • <fidel-offline-status>: Offline status

    One always-visible line, "Online." or "You are offline. 3 lessons are saved on this phone.", and a list of saved lessons.

  • <fidel-download-later>: Download when I'm online

    The lesson waits in a queue and downloads into the offline cache as soon as the phone is online.

Formsቅጾች

Real labels and fields, errors in words, drafts, offline sending and Amharic typing.

  • <fidel-input>: Text field

    A one-line text field with a real label, hints, errors in words, keyboard-language and Caps Lock hints, and Listen.

  • <fidel-textarea>: Long text field

    The same as <fidel-input>, for longer text.

  • <fidel-choice>: Radio buttons or checkboxes

    A <fieldset> with a <legend> and real radio buttons or checkboxes, 44 px rows.

  • <fidel-select>: Select with search

    A native <select>, optionally with a real "Search the list" box that says how many options match.

  • <fidel-file>: File field

    A native file field: types and size limit in words, the chosen file's name and size, and Remove.

  • <fidel-date>: Date field

    A native date field with the same date in the Ethiopian calendar under it, read with the field.

  • <fidel-error-summary>: Error summary

    On submit, "2 fields need fixing" with a link to each field; focus moves to it and nothing typed is lost.

  • <fidel-form>: Form with drafts and offline sending

    Wraps your <form>: saves a draft as you type, sends later when offline, never sends twice, and adds the error summary.

  • <fidel-amharic-keyboard>: Amharic keyboard

    Type Amharic with no Amharic keyboard installed: choose the consonant, then its form.

  • <fidel-voice-note>: Voice note

    Record a short voice message, play it back, then send it; no speech-to-text.

Career: jobs, certificates and eventsሙያ፦ ሥራዎች፣ የምስክር ወረቀቶች እና ዝግጅቶች

Job adverts, verified certificates and live sessions, with schema.org data.

  • <fidel-job-card>: Job card

    A job advert from a Fidel server: employer, place, closing date in both calendars, accommodations, and a summary to read or listen to.

  • <fidel-certificate>: Verified certificate

    A certificate card that always asks the Fidel server: "✓ Verified certificate", revoked, or not found.

  • <fidel-event-card>: Live session card

    A live session with its access support in words, "Request access support", "Add to calendar" and, later, the recording.

Navigation and helpአሰሳ እና እገዛ

Skip links, big Previous and Next links, help in the same place, and no time-outs.

  • <fidel-skip-link>: Skip link

    A "Skip to the lesson" link, hidden until it has keyboard focus, that moves focus to the lesson.

  • <fidel-step-nav>: Big Previous and Next links

    Previous and Next links at the end of a lesson, with "Lesson 3 of 8", at least 48 px tall.

  • <fidel-help>: Help in the same place

    A "Get help" button that lists the help routes you give, text first: chat, email, an interpreter video call, phone.

  • <fidel-session-keeper>: Never lose work to a time-out

    Before your time-out, a dialog asks "Do you need more time?" with "Yes, more time" focused.

Display and languageማሳያ እና ቋንቋ

Text size and colours, a language switch for one section, and dates in both calendars.

  • <fidel-display-prefs>: Display settings

    A "Display settings" dialog: text size, line spacing, colours, stop motion, thicker focus and an easy-read font.

  • <fidel-lang>: Language for one section

    Switch language for one section, not the whole page; each button is written in its own language.

  • <fidel-ethiopian-date>: Ethiopian date

    A date in both calendars inside a real <time>.
